children: Barclays expects the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in September and again in December, following chair Kevin Warsh's latest remarks that signaled a more hawkish policy stance, the brokerage said in a note on Friday.
Previously the Wall Street brokerage had expected the Fed to keep rates unchanged through the remainder of the year.
